voltage_notes: 3.3V logic only (5V will damage the chip). The onboard LED on GPIO2 is active-low (LOW = on). GPIO6-11 are the flash bus - never use. GPIO0/2/15 are strapping pins that set the boot mode; GPIO1/3 are the UART0 debug console - avoid repurposing. GPIO outputs are limited to ~12mA (vs 40mA on ESP32) - add a series resistor when driving an LED directly.
